data.title: Stag at Sharkey's
data.tombstone: Stag at Sharkey's, 1909. George Bellows (American, 1882–1925). Oil on canvas; framed: 110 x 140.5 x 8.5 cm (43 5/16 x 55 5/16 x 3 3/8 in.); unframed: 92 x 122.6 cm (36 1/4 x 48 1/4 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Hinman B. Hurlbut Collection, 1922.1133

data.title: Twilight in the Wilderness
data.tombstone: Twilight in the Wilderness, 1860. Frederic Edwin Church (American, 1826–1900). Oil on canvas; unframed: 101.6 x 162.6 cm (40 x 64 in.); framed: 124 x 185 x 13 cm (48 13/16 x 72 13/16 x 5 1/8 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Mr. and Mrs. William H. Marlatt Fund, 1965.233
data.creditline: Mr. and Mrs. William H. Marlatt Fund

data.title: The Red Kerchief
data.tombstone: The Red Kerchief (Femme à la capeline rouge), c. 1868–73. Claude Monet (French, 1840–1926). Oil on fabric; framed: 128.3 x 105.7 x 14.6 cm (50 1/2 x 41 5/8 x 5 3/4 in.); unframed: 99 x 79.8 cm (39 x 31 7/16 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Bequest of Leonard C. Hanna Jr., 1958.39
data.creditline: Bequest of Leonard C. Hanna Jr.

data.title: Peregrine Falcons (Duck Hawks)
data.tombstone: Peregrine Falcons (Duck Hawks), c. 1827. John James Audubon (American, born Haiti, 1785–1851). Oil on canvas; framed: 74.9 x 101 x 10.2 cm (29 1/2 x 39 3/4 x 4 in.); unframed: 64.5 x 91.5 cm (25 3/8 x 36 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Gift of the American Foundation for the Maud E. and Warren H. Corning Botanical Collection, 1964.351
data.creditline: Gift of the American Foundation for the Maud E. and Warren H. Corning Botanical Collection

data.title: Portrait of a Woman
